WITH line_totals AS (
    SELECT b.budget_id,
           COALESCE(SUM(e.cost), 0) AS total_cost,
           COUNT(e.expense_id) AS expense_count
    FROM budget AS b
    LEFT JOIN expense AS e ON e.link_to_budget = b.budget_id
    GROUP BY b.budget_id
), overall_average AS (
    SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_total
    FROM line_totals
), above_average AS (
    SELECT lt.total_cost, lt.expense_count, oa.average_total
    FROM line_totals AS lt
    CROSS JOIN overall_average AS oa
    WHERE lt.total_cost > oa.average_total
)
SELECT AVG(total_cost) AS average_of_totals,
       SUM(expense_count) AS total_expense_count,
       AVG(total_cost - average_total) AS average_excess
FROM above_average;

assumptions.assumption: Budget lines with no expenses have total cost 0, and the comparison average is over every row in budget.
